provenance.canonical-source: switch/internal/switch.ts (the real Lit component — this session's material-web clone is NOT tokens-only, the same finding checkbox.m3.json first recorded for this whole clone; re-confirmed here, not assumed, per that column's own closing caveat), switch/internal/{_switch.scss,_track.scss,_handle.scss,_icon.scss} (the shipped styles source, four files, read in full), switch/switch.ts (the <md-switch> registration), switch/internal/switch_test.ts (the label-activation and form-submission proofs). Tokens: tokens/versions/v0_192/_md-comp-switch.scss (the pinned edition) and tokens/versions/latest/sass/_md-comp-switch.scss (edition diff only, see edition-pin). Colour/shape/state resolution through tokens/versions/v0_192/{_md-sys-color.scss,_md-sys-shape.scss,_md-sys-state.scss}.
provenance.edition-pin: v0.192, per the owner's registry-wide decision. UNLIKE every other component this pipeline has pinned so far, switch's edition diff is NOT a small addition — `latest`'s _md-comp-switch.scss is a WHOLESALE REDESIGN: v0.192's token function is REPLACED by a flat file of individually-deprecated `$variable` declarations (Sass module vars, not a values() function), several core tokens change VALUE not just name (`$handle-height`/`$handle-width` deprecated at 20px flat, replacing the unselected/selected 16px/24px split this column relies on), and a whole new `focus-indicator-*` family appears (color/offset/thickness, sourced from md-sys-color.secondary) that v0.192 does not have at all. FLAGGED LOUDLY FOR THE OWNER: this is the largest edition delta this registry has found in any component so far — pinning v0.192 is not a minor conservatism here, it is the difference between the CURRENT documented Material 3 switch and a design Google has since deprecated in its own token source. The values in this column are all v0.192, per standing policy, not relitigated.
provenance.state-opacities: md-sys-state.values(), v0.192: hover-state-layer-opacity 0.08, focus-state-layer-opacity 0.12, pressed-state-layer-opacity 0.12 — the SAME edition-dependent trio checkbox.m3.json already flagged for this component too; `latest` does not change these three specific numbers even though it changes nearly everything else about this component.
provenance.primary/on-primary/on-surface/on-surface: md-sys-color.values-light()/values-dark(), v0.192 — the SAME hex pairs every M3 column in this pipeline resolves (#6750a4/#d0bcff primary, #1d1b20/#e6e0e9 on-surface, #49454f/#cac4d0 on-surface-variant, #79747e/#938f99 outline — the last of these newly needed here, re-derived from input.m3.json's own already-extracted outline value since it resolves through the identical md-sys-color function). Re-derived here for a self-contained column, not borrowed.
provenance.primary-container/on-primary-container: md-sys-color.values-light()/values-dark(). primary-container is EDITION-STABLE: #eaddff/#4f378b in both v0.192 and latest. on-primary-container is NOT — one of exactly four sys-color roles that differ between editions (alert.m3.json and chip.m3.json both already flagged this family): v0.192 resolves it to primary10 = #21005d in light mode (latest: primary30 = #4f378b); dark is #eaddff in both editions. THIS COLUMN USES THE v0.192 VALUE (#21005d light / #eaddff dark), per standing policy.
provenance.surface-container-highest: md-sys-color.values-light()/values-dark() -> neutral90/neutral22 -> #e6e0e9/#36343b, the SAME value card.m3.json's own filled-variant container colour already resolved (re-derived here, not borrowed).
provenance.container-tokens: track-width: 52px, track-height: 32px, track-outline-width: 2px, track-shape: corner-full (9999px) — ALL hardcoded literals, both editions. unselected-handle-height/-width: 16px; selected-handle-height/-width: 24px — the thumb GROWS on selection, a real CSS-driven size change (`internal/_handle.scss` `.selected .handle { height: ...; width: ... }`). pressed-handle-height/-width: 28px, REGARDLESS of selected state — bigger than either resting size (`internal/_handle.scss` `.selected:not(.disabled):active .handle, .unselected:not(.disabled):active .handle`), the 'overshoot' effect (source comment on `.handle-container`'s own transition: `cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275)` — 'this easing is custom to perform the overshoot animation'). handle-shape: corner-full. icon-size/selected-icon-size: BOTH 16px — the icon does NOT grow with the handle, a real, deliberate contrast confirmed by reading both tokens side by side.
provenance.handle-slide-mechanism: `internal/_handle.scss`: `.handle-container { transition: margin 300ms cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275) }`, `$margin: calc(track-width - track-height)` = 52-32 = 20px, `.selected .handle-container { margin-inline-start: $margin }`, `.unselected .handle-container { margin-inline-end: $margin }` — M3 slides its handle via MARGIN on a wrapper, not `transform`, a different MECHANISM from Salt's/shadcn's own `transform: translateX(...)`. This chassis collapses `.handle-container` onto the thumb element itself (declared approximation, see the matrix doc), applying the margin directly to `[data-slot="switch-thumb"]`.
provenance.track-colour-tokens-are-interaction-inva: RE-VERIFIED BY READING THE TOKEN VALUES DIRECTLY, not just the selector names, because the first pass assumed hover/focus/pressed would recolour the track the way checkbox's own M3 box did. They do not: `unselected-hover-track-color`/`unselected-focus-track-color`/`unselected-pressed-track-color` ALL equal `unselected-track-color` (surface-container-highest); `selected-hover-track-color`/`selected-focus-track-color`/`selected-pressed-track-color` ALL equal `selected-track-color` (primary); `unselected-hover-track-outline-color`/`unselected-focus-track-outline-color`/`unselected-pressed-track-outline-color` ALL equal `unselected-track-outline-color` (outline). The track's colour never changes on any interaction — see style.track.hover/.focus/.pressed and state.hover's finding.
provenance.handle-colour-tokens-collapse-hover-focu: Also re-verified directly: `unselected-hover-handle-color`/`unselected-focus-handle-color`/`unselected-pressed-handle-color` are ALL `on-surface-variant`; `selected-hover-handle-color`/`selected-focus-handle-color`/`selected-pressed-handle-color` are ALL `primary-container`. M3 does not distinguish hover from focus from pressed by COLOUR at all for the handle, only by SIZE (pressed alone grows it further) and by the ripple's own opacity (0.08/0.12/0.12). style.thumb.hover in this column's template row is reused for the focus and pressed CASES too, since the colour value is identical across all three.
provenance.unused-disabled-unselected-track-tokens: `disabled-unselected-track-color` and `disabled-unselected-track-outline-color` are BOTH DEFINED in _md-comp-switch.scss but genuinely UNUSED anywhere in `internal/_track.scss` — grepped directly, no selector references either. The unselected disabled track instead falls through to its ORDINARY rest colour (surface-container-highest / outline) dimmed by the general `disabled-track-opacity: 0.12` rule, never touching these two named tokens at all. The same class of 'a capability the token set declares but the CSS never expresses' finding checkbox.salt.json's no-success-styling note already recorded for a different system.
provenance.disabled-opacities: disabled-track-opacity: 0.12 (uniform, both selection states). disabled-unselected-handle-opacity: 0.38. disabled-selected-handle-opacity: 1 — NOT DIMMED AT ALL, re-checked twice against the raw token value because it reads like it should be 0.1-something; it is genuinely 1. disabled-unselected-icon-opacity/disabled-selected-icon-opacity: both 0.38.
provenance.state-layer-size-shape: state-layer-size: 40px, state-layer-shape: corner-full (9999px) — drawn by `md-ripple`, sized independently of BOTH the track (32-52px) and the handle (16-28px), living inside `.handle-container` (i.e. centred on the handle, not the track) — not reproduced as its own element, see the matrix doc's 'Declared approximations'.
provenance.label-click-delegation: switch.ts constructor: `this.addEventListener('click', (event: MouseEvent) => { if (!isActivationClick(event) || !this.input) { return; } this.focus(); dispatchActivationClick(this.input); })`, the IDENTICAL mechanism checkbox.m3.json's own label-click-delegation cited, importing from the same form-label-activation.js module.
provenance.keyboard-enter-addition: switch.ts constructor, quoted directly because it is the headline behavioural finding of this whole column: `// Add the aria keyboard interaction pattern for switch and the Enter key. // See https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/switch/.` followed by a real keydown listener calling `this.input.click()` on Enter, guarded by `!this.disabled`. Checkbox's own M3 column had NO keydown listener of any kind; this one does, and the source comment names its own justification directly.
provenance.form-participation: getFormValue() returns `this.selected ? this.value : null` (value defaults to the literal 'on'); formResetCallback(): `this.selected = this.hasAttribute('selected')` — reads the raw ATTRIBUTE not the property, source comment: 'The selected property does not reflect, so the original attribute set by the user is used to determine the default value'; [createValidator]() returns `new CheckboxValidator(...)`, REUSING checkbox's own validator class verbatim.
provenance.no-warning-no-error-family: CONFIRMED ABSENCE, grepped directly: neither edition of _md-comp-switch.scss contains the string 'error' or 'warning' anywhere. Switch has NO validation tone in M3 at all — the exact inverse of checkbox's finding that M3 shipped a full error-* family.

structure.shell.source: switch.ts render() has no label anywhere in the shadow DOM

structure.track.source: render(): ${this.renderHandle()} — a real, separate track element, SIBLING of the (not its parent)

structure.icon.source: renderIcons() renders BOTH an on-icon and off-icon <slot>, gated by `icons`/`showOnlySelectedIcon` — @property({type:Boolean}) icons = false, so both default OFF

behavior.role.value: explicit `role="switch"` written on the native <input>; aria-checked free from the native `checked` property once the role is applied

behavior.keyboard-activation.source: see keyboard-enter-addition — enterActivates=true, Space handled natively PLUS Enter explicitly added via a keydown listener citing the APG switch pattern directly in a source comment

behavior.label-click-target.value: the track/thumb itself, PLUS an explicit redirect from any ancestor <label> click a consumer supplies

behavior.disabled-handling.value: native ?disabled on the input, PLUS transitions explicitly suppressed on the track/handle around the disabled boundary
behavior.disabled-handling.source: internal/_track.scss `.disabled .track::before, .disabled .track::after { transition: none }`; internal/_handle.scss `.disabled .handle-container { transition: none }`, `.disabled .handle, .disabled .handle::before { transition: none }`

behavior.readonly.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no readonly-* token in either edition, no readOnly property in switch.ts

behavior.form-participation.value: a full form-associated custom element delegating validity to a REUSED CheckboxValidator instance

prop.checked-shape.source: @property({type:Boolean}) selected = false — no indeterminate property anywhere in internal/switch.ts

prop.required.source: @property({type:Boolean}) required, wired directly into CheckboxValidator's constraint-validation computation

prop.size.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no size-related @property anywhere; track/handle dimensions are fixed literals in every instance

slot.label.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no label text owned; always external, see behavior.label-click-target

slot.composes.note: an external, consumer-authored <label> (behavior.label-click-target); checkbox/radio/toggle-button are the explicitly separate canonical rows

state.rest.value: a surface-container-highest-filled track with a 2px outline-coloured border; an outline-coloured, 16px thumb
state.rest.note: smaller than its checked size — see state.checked

state.checked.value: track fill moves to primary with its outline REMOVED (0px, not recoloured); thumb GROWS 16px->24px, recolours outline->on-primary, and slides via margin-inline-start (not transform)
state.checked.note: the fourth sighting of M3's fill-replaces-stroke idiom in this registry

state.hover.value: the TRACK shows NO colour change at all (re-verified directly against the token values); only the THUMB recolours (on-surface-variant unselected / primary-container selected)
state.hover.note: a genuinely different distribution of interactive feedback from Salt, whose track DOES recolour on hover

state.focus.value: same track-invariant / thumb-only-recolour story as hover, plus a 12%-opacity state layer and a separate md-focus-ring element not reproduced here

state.pressed.value: same thumb colour as hover/focus (M3 does not differentiate by colour), but the thumb balloons to 28x28px regardless of selected state — the 'overshoot' effect

state.disabled.value: four different numbers: track 0.12 uniform; thumb 0.38 unselected but 1 (undimmed) selected; icon 0.38 either way
state.disabled.note: a real, deliberate asymmetry — see disabled-opacities

style.track.size@sm.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no size prop, dimensions are fixed literals

style.track.border-width.source: track-outline-width — the UNSELECTED value; style.track.checked removes it entirely

style.track.checked.source: selected-track-color: primary; track-outline-width overridden to 0 for the selected case

style.track.hover.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — see track-colour-tokens-are-interaction-invariant; nothing for this row to express

style.track.disabled.source: disabled-track-opacity: 0.12, applied uniformly regardless of selection state

style.thumb.rest.source: unselected-handle-color: outline; margin-inline-end: track-width - track-height = 52-32 = 20px, the REST-side position

style.thumb.checked.source: selected-handle-color: on-primary; margin-inline-start: 20px, the CHECKED-side position, mirroring style.thumb.rest's margin-inline-end

style.thumb.hover.source: unselected-hover-handle-color: on-surface-variant — the UNSELECTED-hover value; the selected-hover variant (primary-container) is recorded in provenance but not separately expressed, the same declared approximation checkbox.m3.json's own box hover used. Reused for focus and pressed too, since all three tokens are numerically identical for a given selection state

style.thumb.disabled@checked.source: disabled-selected-handle-color: surface; disabled-selected-handle-opacity: 1 — NOT dimmed, the real asymmetry

style.icon.size.source: icon-size/selected-icon-size: BOTH 16px — the icon does NOT grow when the handle does, a real, deliberate contrast

style.root.disabled.note: M3's real disabled treatment is per-part and asymmetric by selection state — see style.track.disabled / style.thumb.disabled(@checked); a single flat root number would misrepresent it

style.root.gap.note: no owned label, nothing to space

style.state-layer.note: documented, not rendered as its own element — see structure.track / provenance.state-layer-size-shape
